caption: Chat wants to ship features.
text: On Twitch, chat wants to play along — but most overlays stay frozen all stream. Polls and Twitch Plays have been done. Chat Ships It does something new: it puts OpenAI Codex on screen as the game mechanic.

caption: Redeem. Approve. Build.
text: A viewer redeems Ship a Feature with one line — add a rubber duck that quacks when someone says LUL. A mod hits ship. Nothing deploys without a human in the loop.

caption: Codex builds live on the overlay.
text: On the OBS overlay, the Codex panel lights up. You watch the plan steps, the diff streaming, and the test light flip green. About a minute later, the widget hot-loads into a sandboxed iframe.

caption: Feature by chat.
text: Morgan's duck quacks on every LUL. Chat can remix widgets. Mods can revert. A patch-notes ticker credits every ship. Safe by design: no network in the sandbox, size budgets, and OpenAI moderation on prompts.

caption: Try the live demo.
text: We built the product with Codex, and Codex is what chat is watching. Open chat-ships-it.vercel.app, try the interactive demo, and star the repo on GitHub. Chat Ships It, by Green Robin Labs, for the Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon.
